verdict.rationale: The evidence documents general sandbox primitives: running shell processes, custom Dockerfile images, and secrets management. Nothing in the pack describes a vendor recipe or guide for running Claude Code, Codex or a similar coding agent inside a Blaxel sandbox. Those generic building blocks do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can run coding agents like Claude Code or Codex inside the sandbox following the vendor's own recipe
